name: Chuck Lorre Cinematic Universe
description: Big Bang Theory, Two and a Half Men, Mom, Young Sheldon, and the rest of Chuck Lorre's TV empire.

name: The Seinfeld Universe
description: Every soup nazi, close talker, and low-talker. If they appeared in a single episode, they're in.

name: Star Trek Universe
description: 60 years of guest stars across TOS, TNG, DS9, Voyager, Enterprise, Discovery, Picard, Strange New Worlds, and more.

name: Star Wars Universe
description: All films plus The Mandalorian, Andor, Obi-Wan, Ahsoka, The Book of Boba Fett, Clone Wars.

name: Doctor Who Universe
description: Over 900 episodes, 40+ years of British television. The deepest guest star pool on Earth.

name: The David Simon Universe
description: The Wire, Treme, The Deuce, We Own This City. The greatest character actor pool in television history.

name: Dick Wolf Universe
description: Law & Order, SVU, Criminal Intent, Organized Crime, Chicago Fire, Chicago PD, Chicago Med, FBI.

name: NBC Comedy Universe
description: The Office, Parks & Rec, Brooklyn Nine-Nine, 30 Rock, Community, Superstore, Abbott Elementary.

name: SNL Alumni
description: Anyone who completed a full season as cast or featured player. The comedy farm team.

name: Ryan Murphy Universe
description: AHS, Glee, Nip/Tuck, Pose, American Crime Story, Dahmer, 9-1-1. He casts the same 40 actors in everything.

name: The Whedonverse
description: Buffy, Angel, Firefly, Dollhouse. Cult following that knows every recurring face by name.

name: The Shondaverse
description: Grey's Anatomy, Scandal, HTGAWM, Bridgerton, Station 19, Private Practice, Queen Charlotte.

name: The Gunniverse
description: Guardians of the Galaxy, The Suicide Squad, Peacemaker, Slither, Super, Brightburn.

name: CSI Universe
description: CSI, CSI: Miami, CSI: NY, CSI: Vegas, CSI: Cyber. Forensic science and guest-star gold.

name: NCIS Universe
description: NCIS, NCIS: LA, NCIS: New Orleans, NCIS: Hawaii, NCIS: Sydney, JAG.

name: British Crime Drama
description: Line of Duty, Broadchurch, Happy Valley, Peaky Blinders, Luther, Sherlock. The entire UK character actor pool.

name: UK Comedy Universe
description: Peep Show, The IT Crowd, The Office UK, Black Books, Fleabag, Extras, Inside No. 9.

name: Tarantino Universe
description: Reservoir Dogs through Once Upon a Time in Hollywood. The same ensemble reinvented across 10 films.

name: Aaron Sorkin Universe
description: The West Wing, Sports Night, The Newsroom, Studio 60. The same brilliant ensemble, different building.

name: Marvel Cinematic Universe
description: Every film and Disney+ series. Main cast is in the DB — this gets the deep supporting cuts.
